xs.$description: Icon beside 12px text, such as in Kbd. It follows the UI scale and is the same at every density.

sm.$description: Small icon, such as a Badge icon or the small Switch. It follows the UI scale and is the same at every density.

default.$description: Icon in a control, at every control size, and the Checkbox, Radio and Switch size. It follows the UI scale and is the same at every density.

lg.$description: Large icon, such as the EmptyState icon. It follows the UI scale and is the same at every density.
